exclusion_note.reason: 703 sepsis patients with onset ≤ 6h ICU excluded (already septic on admission — unpredictable). First 6 hours of all patients kept for training (valid signal).

full_label.label_strategy: Full label: SepsisLabel=1 from t_onset-6h until discharge (PhysioNet default). Includes already-septic post-onset hours.

early_warning.label_strategy: Early-warning only: rows where ICULOS >= t_onset are dropped (t_onset = first SepsisLabel=1 + 6). Model only sees the pre-onset trajectory.
